text.tspan: Covers US 2.0.1 and 2.0.6. The map exists (
[Open the map from another page (2.0.1 AT3, Proposed)]
The first time the map opens, the page loads the boundaries. They are not loaded again during the visit.
[No valid session or account not approved]
The map draws a polygon for every protected area, so a protected area with no Site also shows.
The default status filter keeps Active Sites and areas with no Site, and hides inactive Sites.
/sites has no status control. /admin/sites has one, so an Admin can show inactive Sites.
[Zoom to a Site that has GPX tracks (2.0.1 AT2, Proposed)]
[Filter by county, type or subtype, and by status on /admin/sites (2.0.6 AT1, AT2)]
Filter and search use the boundaries that are already loaded. They make no server call.
Cards View uses getSitesOnline and the same search box and county filter.
Open questions: GPX storage (see US 2.0.9) and the time window of tracks to show.
